status: PASS: independent read-only Boolean-normalization source/math review

checks.guarded_rows: At guard0 both original and normalized rows are tautologies. At guard1, capping each positive weight at the demand preserves a Boolean threshold. Dividing by the gcd of the capped weights and taking the ceiling of demand/gcd is exact; the guard coefficient is correctly excluded from that gcd.
checks.shared_rows: For sum(c_j*x_j)<=0, convert positive coefficients to complementary literals and use threshold D=sum(c_j>0)c_j. Each positive coefficient is at most D, so capping leaves it unchanged and the capped-weight gcd divides D. Expansion back to signed selectors therefore has exactly zero RHS.
checks.edge_cases: Empty guarded support forces the guard absent. An all-nonpositive shared row is a tautology. Integer arithmetic is BigInt throughout.
checks.scope: These transformations are equivalent for Boolean selectors. They may strengthen the real unit-box relaxation, so they must not be described as equivalent real-LP row compression.
